lead: Our move planner guides your team before, during and after an office relocation, so your focus stays on your business until the move is complete.
card_blurb: A practical checklist and schedule that prepares your team for every stage of an office move.
meta_title: Office Move Planner and Checklist | BRS
meta_description: Use the BRS move planner to prepare for an office relocation: packing and labeling tips, scheduling, elevator booking and post-move support.
overview: Moving is not simple. The larger the move, the more complex the planning. Good planning answers the where, when, why, who and how of your move, with the goal of a smooth transition and minimal interruption to your operation.

BRS provides a move planner checklist with every estimate. It starts before your move and offers recommendations through to after you are settled. Our scheduling is based on historical data and past moving experience.
Four things hold true for every move: every move is unique, the process is basically the same, you need a plan, and you should expect the unexpected.

benefits.title: Clear tasks for every stage
benefits.text: The checklist covers delivery dates, packing, space protection, unpacking and post-move shifting.

benefits.title: Fewer surprises on move day
benefits.text: Labeling, packing and elevator guidance help your staff prepare, and BRS plans for the unexpected.

benefits.title: Schedules that limit disruption
benefits.text: We coordinate labor, materials and equipment into a realistic, cost-effective schedule.

included: Move planner checklist with every estimate
Desk, file cabinet and shelving preparation instructions
Coding and labeling of furniture and cartons
BRS cartons or crates supplied for packing
Padded, secure transport for computers and electronic equipment
Wrapping of pictures, maps and boards
Guidance on security, keys and elevator arrangements
Post-move shifting and removal of unwanted furniture on request

process.title: Plan and organize
process.text: Your Move Coordinator and our Project Manager set the scope, floor plan requirements and schedule.

process.title: Prepare your team
process.text: Staff pack and label using the checklist, and notify building management, vendors and clients.

process.title: Move on schedule
process.text: Many office moves take place on weekdays after 5 PM or on weekends, when traffic is lighter and elevators are available.

process.title: Unpack and follow up
process.text: We support unpacking and any shifting or furniture removal after the move.

who_for: Departments preparing staff for a move
Offices moving after hours or on weekends

faq.q: When is the move planner provided?
faq.a: BRS provides the move planner checklist with every estimate we perform.

faq.q: Why are office moves often scheduled after 5 PM or on weekends?
faq.a: That timing is generally cost-effective because of lighter traffic, relaxed parking restrictions and exclusive use of building elevators, even though it is considered premium overtime.

faq.q: Where should I put labels on cartons?
faq.a: On the front of each carton, not the top. Cartons are stacked three high, so front labels are easy to see.
